name: LOLA Site01 adjusted DEM
notes: Connecting Ridge ROI 1 supplies the lunar pilot. It is an interpolated research product, not a finalized base location; uncertainty clones are not propagated.

name: Copernicus GLO-30 DSM
notes: Public AWS mirror needs no account. DSM includes vegetation and structures. Three manual Earth windows validate the pipeline; they are not discoveries. Credit: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 / DLR / Airbus.

name: NASA POWER hourly meteorology
notes: Air temperature, wind speed and surface shortwave radiation are context only. Local solar time is explicit. Air temperature is not land-surface temperature; radiation is not lunar geometric illumination.

name: LOLA polar illumination
notes: Long-term averages are not an hourly illumination time series. Use native-resolution pixels and consistent horizon/observer-height assumptions.

name: LRO Diviner PRP / PCP / Level 3
notes: Select the specific thermal product and channels. Mask invalid values such as -9999; align local lunar phase, not Earth calendar time.

name: LRO Mini-RF radar
notes: Mini-RF, Sentinel-1 and PALSAR use different wavelengths and geometries. Raw backscatter is not directly comparable; validate any CPR or roughness proxy.

name: Chandrayaan-1 Moon Mineralogy Mapper
notes: Match wavelengths, corrections and units before spectral-angle comparison. Mineral composition is distinct from thermal-emissivity proxies.

name: MOD11A1 v061 land-surface temperature
notes: Public Planetary Computer mirror imported with temporary SAS tokens kept in memory. January 2025 valid paired days: 14 / 18 / 14; Australian accepted samples carry the lower mandatory-QA flag. Sparse overpasses are not hourly thermal cycles.

name: ASTER AG100 v003 emissivity
notes: Use emissivity channels with matching spectral response. ASTER SWIR stopped functioning in April 2008; later SWIR observations cannot be assumed available.

name: EMIT surface mineral spectra
notes: Check dryland coverage, latitude limits, quality masks and collection version for each ROI. No global spectral coverage is implied.

name: ESA CCI permafrost active-layer thickness
notes: The linked 1997-2019 product is an older release. Review newer versions. Active-layer thickness is a proxy, not lunar or Martian subsurface ice depth.

name: SMAP SPL3SMP_E soil moisture
notes: Review the selected version and native footprint. Soil moisture does not measure buried ice or a 3-5 m excavation profile.

name: MGS MOLA MEGDR
notes: Regional elevation context only; it cannot resolve 100 m landing slopes. Keep the Mars geoid height reference distinct from Earth elevation.

name: CTX global image mosaic
resolution: About 5-6 m imagery; not a DTM
notes: Imagery supports morphology and context. Slopes require a separately produced stereo DTM, not brightness gradients in a mosaic.

name: CTX / HiRISE / HRSC terrain products
notes: Inventory actual DTM footprints first. HiRISE 1-5 m terrain coverage is limited; images alone do not establish a fine-scale slope limit.

name: THEMIS thermal products
notes: Atmosphere and retrieval methods differ between planets. Use a documented rank-based proxy where absolute thermal inertia is not comparable.

name: Mars SWIM subsurface ice mapping
resolution: Regional synthesis, not a uniform depth sounding
notes: SWIM2 1-5 m composite imported. AP-105 ice consistency is 0.5; this is not a probability, ice fraction or direct depth and is not scored against soil moisture.

name: MRO CRISM spectra
notes: Apply atmospheric and photometric corrections, bad-band masks and common wavelength sampling before comparison with Earth spectra.

name: Mars Climate Database and lander weather
resolution: Model grid; in-situ records at specific landers
notes: Align local solar phase and seasonal solar longitude Ls. REMS at Gale and MEDA at Jezero do not directly observe the five northern reference regions.

name: Sentinel-1 / Sentinel-2
resolution: C-band radar / optical bands at 10-60 m
notes: Public Planetary Computer mirror imported B04 and SCL at all three Earth windows. BOA reflectance uses XML offset/scale and cloud/land masking. No matched Mars image-texture product is scored.

name: ALOS PALSAR products
notes: Download access may need a JAXA account. Dry-sand radar penetration cannot be generalized to all soils or used as a direct ice-depth measurement.

name: MERRA-2 aerosol diagnostics
notes: Select aerosol diagnostics separately from air temperature. Preserve units, grid support and the same analysis years across candidate sites.

name: CSA synthetic-aperture radar tutorial
resolution: Tutorial code; not a measurement dataset
notes: Use as a processing reference. NASA Worldview and other viewers are also discovery tools, not automatically quantitative input products.

name: HiRISE Gale DTM
notes: Imported a native row stripe, with hashes for the range. Gale data is not assigned to AP-105. Earth GLO-30 cannot provide 1-5 m slopes.

name: Curiosity REMS sol 1000
resolution: 1 Hz source samples; hourly LMST bin means
notes: 21,086 quality-filtered air-temperature samples. Wind remains missing after filtering. One 2015 sol is not seasonally matched to Earth January 2025.

name: MGS TES numeric nighttime thermal inertia
notes: Native thermal inertia and mask imported: AP-105 value 181, mask 1. This is not 100 m THEMIS data; Earth LST contrast has different units.

name: NASA NAIF SPICE ephemerides and orientations
resolution: DE440s, lunar DE421 ME orientation, Earth ITRF93
notes: Real ephemerides plus measured DEM products produce a finite-horizon solar model. Observer 2 m, horizon radius 1 km; no distant terrain, cloud, refraction or solar-disc model.

name: Adjusted LOLA south-polar DEM
resolution: 20 m native; 100 m grid, 2 km windows
notes: Native DEM crops are imported independently at all nine additional lunar study points. Common-grid slopes and finite 1 km horizon models do not establish landing safety.

name: Published Artemis-region representative study points
resolution: Named study points; 2 km analysis windows
notes: Wueller et al. (2026), doi:10.1029/2025JE009434. Nine named points are checked against original shapefile geometry. A point is not the entire region or a finalized landing selection.

name: USGS MOLA / HRSC global DEM blend
resolution: 200 m nominal native grid; 500 m analysis grid, 20 km windows
notes: Seven Mars study windows have independent native elevation crops. R5 compares regional RMS height against Earth at the same analysis scale. Regional slopes remain context only for the finer R1 landing-slope requirement.

name: USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature
notes: Current footprint centres locate Deuteronilus Mensae, Utopia Planitia, Phlegra Montes and Erebus Montes regional samples. Some centres lie outside the provisional 30-45 N landing band. These are not selected SkyFall landing sites.
